notes: These rows are host institutions, not subjects. The OeAD names no institution list; the 22 names come from an unofficial Wikipedia table of Austrian federal universities and are one reading of all Austrian universities.

The Interdisciplinary Transformation University Austria in Linz is shown as public in Wikipedia navigation but is not in its table; Eurydice counts 23 public universities. It is not recorded here because no source ties it to this grant.
Non-university research institutes: eligibility is decided individually by the OeAD, and the supervisor must also teach at a university.
